architecture.A: Independent observations of approved context, current continuity/ownership/health/history/privilege/recovery; protected role/sink requirements and capture readiness; failed/unknown prerequisite STOP. No collection performed.
architecture.B: Externally controlled separately authorized ordinary execution of the unchanged approved client. This design neither launches nor provides an SGX executor; observation boundary consumes independently permitted process/outcome/sink evidence only.
architecture.C: Preserve every available original response/image/stream/kernel observation and actual outcome; repeat no ioctl. Completion/loss/owner/boot facts remain explicit and UNKNOWN when missing.

formal_proof_obligation.variables: C bound context; P observed exact executable/process instance; I eligible single ioctl; R original post-call object; O image; K kernel observation; E independently preserved observation set.
formal_proof_obligation.attribution: Attr_E(K,I,R,C) requires observed context continuity, proven approved process instance, uniquely eligible I for P/device/action, causal output provenance R<-P<-I, original integrity, documented accepted-event meaning for K, sufficient completeness/exclusion of stale/unrelated producers, and a documented causal association K<-I OR a proved exclusive-current-operation association under a trusted observation model.
formal_proof_obligation.uniqueness: There exists exactly one eligible I consistent with the evidence; no alternate invocation/boot/producer/event history explains K and R. Counts/labels alone do not establish uniqueness.
formal_proof_obligation.observable_constraints: Every premise must be justified by an ALLOWED actual observation/interface specification. No hidden emitter/token/sequence is assumed. Any missing premise makes Attr UNKNOWN, not false or true.
formal_proof_obligation.trust_model: Relies on the independently reviewed OS/collector and pinned artifacts plus observed access/ownership boundaries; no claim of adversarial privileged-host authenticity or power-loss survival. A declared trusted collector without provenance is not proof.
formal_proof_obligation.determinism: Only a complete causal or exclusion proof is accepted as deterministic scoped attribution; timestamp proximity alone is probabilistic and insufficient.

destination_contract.parent: Independently verified directory ancestry/identity/owner, no symlink traversal or untrusted writer; private evidence directory owned by the permitted effective account with mode0700. Live privilege predicate requires euid0; no target account/path invented.
destination_contract.binding: Review binds each logical role to its resolved parent+basename and permissions, not just a string; no role aliasing, reused destination or inode/hardlink collision.
destination_contract.creation: Response/image names remain absent before client writes because approved exporter uses exclusive create; never pre-create their files. Stream/receipt sinks may be exclusively created by the observation layer, but external actor must prove its actual sink binding. No launcher implementation specified.
destination_contract.type_and_mode: Regular evidence files, nlink1, verified owner, mode0600; no symlink/FIFO/device. Approved client inode must be protected/identity-verified with execution permissions separately reviewed, not inferred from evidence-file0600.
destination_contract.durability: Check available write/fsync/close outcomes and parent-directory sync; retain original order. fsync success is not a guarantee after arbitrary power loss.
destination_contract.reread: Reopen without following links, verify regular type/link/owner/inode/size and reread bytes; compare raw4268/image4096 equality at offset172 when complete; size/hash establish integrity not provenance.
destination_contract.ordering: Preserve all available originals before derived image/copy/analysis; approved client attempts raw preservation before success summary/image handling. Raw-write failure may still leave image/other evidence; retain every produced original and partial. Do not manufacture absent original image.
destination_contract.failure: Retain created/partial files and errors; no unlink/overwrite/reuse. If storage prevents a receipt, record that uncertainty where still possible; no claim of durable evidence.

triangle_evidence_policy.label: TRIANGLE ESTABLISHED
triangle_evidence_policy.requires: Trusted current-context approved process/ioctl and artifact association; full response with necessary tuple operation_errno0/outcome2/phase9/events7/color_observed1; attributable accepted TA/end-render/3D-free; original4096 preserved and response[172:] identical; checked validation copy at all1024 pixels consistent with frozen white geometry/zero background/layout; independent archive verification; no unresolved material provenance/loss/edge contradiction.
triangle_evidence_policy.forbidden_shortcuts: Exit/ledger/hash/nonzero count/reference image alone; reporting zeros alone.

triangle_evidence_policy.label: READBACK PRESENT BUT TRIANGLE NOT ESTABLISHED
triangle_evidence_policy.requires: Original candidate image bytes actually retained, with image presence directly established; missing completion/provenance, geometric contradiction or unresolved edge interpretation recorded.
triangle_evidence_policy.limit: If producer provenance absent, say image bytes present and hardware-readback provenance UNKNOWN; do not imply GPU readback.

triangle_evidence_policy.label: EXECUTION OBSERVED BUT RASTER RESULT UNKNOWN
triangle_evidence_policy.requires: A directly attributable execution/submission/completion observation that establishes exactly the named stage; raster/image stage not adequately observed.
triangle_evidence_policy.limit: Specify which stage is observed. TA accepted completion permits TA-fire INFERRED if not directly observed; does not establish raster completion.

triangle_evidence_policy.label: EXECUTION UNKNOWN
triangle_evidence_policy.requires: Possible ioctl with failed/ambiguous/lost/incomplete attribution, or no direct hardware execution proof.
triangle_evidence_policy.limit: Can retain a complete response/image while actual execution remains UNKNOWN; neither implies successful GPU behavior.

sampling_edge_limit: Convention unqualified; complete image positions and values checked, boundary discrepancies remain unresolved until independently reviewed; neither count match nor synthetic reference is proof.
